[SWS_PER_00321]
d
The
Persistency
shall ensure that the space actually allocated
by a
storage
never surpasses the amount configured by
PersistencyDeploy-
ment
.
maximumAllowedSize
.
c
(RS_PER_00010, RS_PER_00011)
This could be ensured by supervising all write accesses to
persistent data
. But
the implementation of the
Persistency
is free to chose other appropriate measures.
The
application
can also poll the amount of storage space currently occupied by a
complete
Key-Value Storage
or
File Storage
by using
ara::per::GetCur-
rentKeyValueStorageSize
or
ara::per::GetCurrentFileStorageSize
, re-
spectively. Naturally, the returned values will not drop below a configured minimum
size (
PersistencyDeployment
.
minimumSustainedSize
) or rise above a config-
ured maximum size (
PersistencyDeployment
.
maximumAllowedSize
).
